top_signals.title: Philippines Eyes New Retail Peso Bond at 25-Year Milestone
top_signals.summary: The Philippines is looking to expand its pool of individual debt investors with a new sale of retail Treasury bonds, according to people familiar with the plan.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Meta's Muse reignites AI disruption fears. Traders are targeting this brokerage stock as next casualty
top_signals.summary: Meta's latest consumer AI product is sending such big shockwaves through the market that it's even inflaming a long-time rivalry in the brokerage business.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Manchester United losses increase despite Ratcliffe cost-cutting and record revenue
